note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because two raw columns change type across rounds: the datasets-server infers `meta` as a 3-field struct from the thin `batch-r01`-`batch-r252` records and then cannot cast the 1694 later records that add `designed` + `domain` (nor the 5 `srl-*` records that add `plant`), and `plan` is a string on 1961 records but a list of strings on 242. Declaring `meta`, `reward`, `plan` and `tool_call.args` as `json` fixes the parquet index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: never absent, but the type varies: a string on 1961 of the 2203 records and a list of strings on the 242 records in `batch-r132`-`batch-r252`. Declared `json` rather than `string` because that union is exactly what breaks the Arrow cast; a reader gets the raw value back and can branch on its type.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; the key set differs per tool across the 7 tool names (`bash`, `read`, `edit`, `grep`, `write`, `search_replace`, `read_file`). No single args key changes value type.

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag over 93 distinct keys with mixed value types (bool, int, float). `success` (bool) is on every record; `cost_steps` on 2198, `tests_passed` on 2165, `http_429` and `http_502` on 1952 each, `tests_failed_as_designed` on 1695. Eleven further keys recur on 6 to 13 records each (`ci_collects_evals`, `dashboard_updated`, `ci_swallows_eval`, `ci_points_at_geval`, `metrics_discriminating`, `ci_gate_updated`, `promptfoo_still_green`, `ci_cache_key_fixed`, `ci_typecheck_updated`, `trace_adapter`, `xfailed`); four recur on exactly 2 records each (`val_mean_after`, `invent_after`, `ok_after`, `clean_after`); the 5 `srl-*` records carry `terminal_only` / `horizon_steps` / `mid_reward_steps`; and 69 keys appear on exactly one record.

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag with three observed shapes: `factory` + `generator` + `round` on the 504 records of rounds 1-252, those three plus `domain` + `designed` on the 1694 records of rounds 253-1104, and those three plus `plant` on the 5 `srl-*` records of rounds 641-645. The three shapes sum to all 2203 records.

disclosures.summary: Five records are dest-stamped leftover-mill payload from `sparse-reward-long-task-factory`, not from this dump's `eval-harness-trajectory-factory`. They keep `meta.factory = sparse-reward-long-task-factory`, `meta.plant = designed`, and the sparse-reward reward keys `terminal_only` / `horizon_steps` / `mid_reward_steps`. They are kept exactly as generated and are counted in the frozen factory-mix census, not re-censused here.

disclosures: Those five records are the only foreign payload in this dataset. The other 2198 records are all `eval-harness-trajectory-factory` episodes with `evh-*` ids, and every one of the 2203 records was generated by `grok-4.6`.

The 1641 records whose goal names a `leftover-*` symptom (and the 1 record whose id does) are same-factory `evh-*` records advertising this dataset's leftover-judge mechanic. Same-factory leftover naming is not mill mix and is not a foreign dump.
Every one of the 34406 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
